args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE NEW landscape1536x1024 TRANSPARENT PNG KFB ink monster character sheet. EXACTLY SIX unique complete actors, THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS.
Supplied PNGs STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image1 defines rounded whole dark ink body, rich soft clay and sculpted lids; image2 defines beautiful handmade clay accessory craft in wood/metal/leather/cloth. New characters, not edits or costume/face copies.
Theme: fictional historical VENETIAN / Renaissance merchant-court society, a little Medici-like artistic wealth, quiet secret-lodge intrigue and a SUBTLE hint of Venetian carnival. Restrained sophisticated accessories rather than fancy-dress overload. Antique gold, muted wine-red, teal, ivory, purple velvet, carved wood, wax seals, restrained brocade and pearl details. No real person likeness or historical reconstruction claim.
MOST IMPORTANT: clearly ink-blob monsters, not masked humans. Two female-read actors. ALL EYES/FACES COMPLETELY UNCOVERED. No mask over any eye, mouth or forehead. Only ONE small carnival mask accessory in whole sheet, held LOW beside the body of bottom-middle actor, away from face. Never a masked ball tableau. No elaborate full robes, large feather plumes, scene/background, lettering, logos or real lodge emblems.

Anatomy/style: every actor ONE complete UPRIGHT FOOTLESS continuous charcoal-black ink splat, subtle deep-violet sheen, huge face directly in goo, thick soft asymmetrical rounded lobes, two small rounded goo hands, a few detached droplets within own cell. No human torso/legs/feet, bust, fur, angular stone or spiky anatomy. Fabric limited to short collar/sash/one small shoulder fold, covers less than quarter of body. Fine tactile sculpted plasticine, soft rounded volumes, fingerprints, selective modeled seams/wear, odd offbeat cartoon appeal, not Pixar human mascots.
Eyes WHITE/IVORY sclera, distinct small RED IRIS, BLACK PUPIL. Thick fully violet-black clay eyelids. No glowing red eyeballs. Facial individuality comes first: wildly different gaze, lids/brows, mouth and lip structures. Irregular ivory teeth where shown, no repeated grins or dangling tongues.

TOP LEFT — FEMALE-READ ART PATRON / COURT GRAND DAME. Broad teardrop blob with two short rolled clay side curls, a tiny gold comb with three large ivory pearls tucked into one curl, muted teal shoulder fold. Exhilarated amused curiosity: one white eye huge and round, opposite lid half-closed, raised curved brow, shallow sideways toothy smile with only two small unequal teeth. Holds ONE short partially opened ivory-and-red folding FAN low across her own belly, other hand curls beside it showing one large oval gold ring. Fan never hides face or eyes. No crown, mask or human neckline.
TOP MIDDLE — MALE-READ DOGE / CEREMONIAL RULER. Very wide squat soft bean, enormous heavy lower lip, huge drooping modeled lids. GOLD CORNO DUCALE cap with rounded distinctive forward horn peak and short red cloth back flap, simple red-and-gold collar. Tired majestic offence: unequal half-lidded white eyes stare DOWN, closed deep crooked pout and one offset lower tooth. Both hands hold ONE absurdly fat brass WAX-SEAL STAMP upright against lower body, round wooden handle visibly gripped; no wax scene. He appears burdened by the weight of making things official.
TOP RIGHT — MALE-READ MERCHANT BANKER. Tall bent pear with an asymmetric side loop, small soft wine-red Renaissance merchant cap and little bronze clasp on brown shoulder strap. Anxious calculating concentration: very wide unequal white eyes point DOWN, inner brow corners lifted, upper lip pinched tight and single square tooth peeking. Holds ONE chunky small WOODEN ABACUS at his belly, clear rectangular frame and THREE SIMPLE ROWS with a few large bronze beads, obvious working rails, no impossible machinery or labels. No spectacles, coin spill or books.
BOTTOM LEFT — MALE-READ GONDOLIER / CANAL STRONGMAN. Broad low near-square blob with two fat rounded crown nubs, small battered straw boater with faded red band, one short ivory-and-navy STRIPED SASH across lower side, not a whole shirt. Explosive wounded indignation: one white eye wide, other squinting in disbelief, one arched brow, skewed rectangular open mouth with three widely spaced unequal teeth and thick curled lower lip. Grips ONE very short broad-ended worn wooden OAR diagonally LOW across own body. No boat/water/floor. Entire oar fits own cell.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — FEMALE-READ COURT CONFIDANTE / SECRET COURIER. Tall slender hooked ink bean with wavy lower lobes, one loose black clay curl, subtle lashes. Small deep-purple hood draped only over crown/back with burgundy lining, face fully exposed. Cool controlled suspicion: narrowed white eyes glance SIDEWAYS, one much larger than other, gently angled brows, almost CLOSED crooked confident lip line, one tiny offset tooth. One hand holds ONE thick folded cream LETTER with a large red wax seal against belly. Other hand dangles ONE small ivory HALF-MASK by its short ribbon LOW beside her HIP, far from eyes/face. The half-mask is plain and modest, subordinate to her actual uncovered expressive face. No dagger, full cloak or invisible body.
BOTTOM RIGHT — MALE-READ SECRET-LODGE KEY KEEPER. Top-heavy crooked ink splat, three little unequal crown drops, small faded violet velvet cap, one short ochre shoulder scrap and one simple bronze circle pendant. Absent-minded earnest confusion: white eyes looking UP in different directions, brows raised into uneven worried arches, large protruding lower lip and just one upper tooth. Holds ONE oversized antique bronze KEY with a simple TRIANGULAR BOW and short thick shaft against body, other hand touches own pendant as if trying to remember which is the credential. No secret symbols, lettering, compass logo, extra mask or robe.

Layout: regular3x2 grid, six LARGE complete individual silhouettes, matching substantial body height across rows. Full actors target450-475px tall inside each512pxcell, generously separated, all hats/curls/props/droplets inside own cell. At least24px outer margins and32px transparent row gaps; no neighbors touching, crossing props or clipped silhouettes. Bottom row not miniature. Face and goo dominate over clothing/props. No gridlines, text, watermark, scene, background gradient, floor, cast-shadow disc, checkerboard or halos. True alpha-zero transparent surroundings, opaque character interiors, clean antialias. Soft upper-left studio light on characters only.
